targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anomalies FROM quality.anomaly_events WHERE is_anomaly AND detected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_grade) product_grade, forecast_period, forecast_quantity_kg, confidence_lower, confidence_upper, model_version, forecast_date FROM demand.forecasts ORDER BY product_grade, created_at DESC;

SELECT product_grade, planned_quantity_kg, safety_stock_kg, production_line, margin_score, start_date, status FROM demand.production_plans WHERE plan_date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY margin_score DESC NULLS LAST;
SELECT material, horizon_days, predicted_price_irr, trend, recommendation, confidence, created_at FROM supply.price_forecasts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT time AS "time", reactor_temp FROM quality.process_readings WHERE batch_id LIKE '%0042%' OR batch_id IN (SELECT batch_id FROM quality.batches WHERE grade='N220' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 200;
SELECT created_at, batch_id, grade, expected_defect_reduction, model_version, rationale FROM quality.process_recommendations ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
